summary: Phase 3 Supabase messenger E2E gate-check. Per the locked test plan, the first required check is: if REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL or REACT_APP_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is empty, the /messages route MUST render the 'Messenger is not configured yet' panel and testing STOPS. Verified: both env vars in /app/frontend/.env are empty strings. Signed in as testfriend1@example.com / pass1234 (login succeeded, redirected to /feed), then navigated to /messages. The page rendered the [data-testid='supabase-not-configured'] panel with the exact copy 'Messenger is not configured yet — Set REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL and REACT_APP_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in /app/frontend/.env, then run the SQL in /app/supabase/schema.sql in your Supabase project to bring Chats, Groups, and Realms online.' No crashes, no console errors on /messages (the only console errors were 401s on the signin page before login, which is expected /api/auth/me prefetch behavior). Per explicit user instruction, I STOPPED here — Chats / Groups / Realms / Realtime cross-browser tests cannot run without a live Supabase backend and the user has not yet provided credentials or applied the SQL schema.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be exercised. REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL and REACT_APP_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are both empty in /app/frontend/.env, so isSupabaseConfigured === false and the not-configured fallback renders correctly. This is the gate behavior the user defined — it is working as designed, but it means no real messaging flow has been validated end-to-end yet.

action_items: USER ACTION (not main agent): Populate REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL and REACT_APP_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in /app/frontend/.env with values from the Supabase project, then restart the frontend (sudo supervisorctl restart frontend).

USER ACTION: Paste /app/supabase/schema.sql into the Supabase SQL editor and run it so the 'messages', 'chats', 'groups', 'realms' (etc.) tables exist before any messaging call. Without this, every Supabase call from messaging.js will fail with 'relation "messages" does not exist'.
After both above are done, re-invoke the testing sub-agent so the Chats / Groups / Realms / Realtime flows can be validated end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: /app/frontend/src/lib/supabase.js correctly guards createClient() behind isSupabaseConfigured, so the absence of env vars does not throw at module-load time.
Good: Messages.jsx exposes the documented data-testid='supabase-not-configured' on the fallback panel, which made the gate check deterministic.
Observation (not blocking): the fallback panel says 'run the SQL in /app/supabase/schema.sqlin your Supabase project' — there's a missing space between 'schema.sql' and 'in'. Cosmetic only.
Observation: /app/frontend/.env ships with the Supabase keys blank. That is correct for a fresh build, but be aware any redeploy will require re-injecting them.

success_rate.frontend: gate check passed (1/1) — full flow not executable without Supabase credentials

test_credentials: testfriend1@example.com / pass1234 (tfone) — login verified working. testfriend2@example.com / pass1234 not exercised (no Supabase backend to message against).
seed_data_creation: None — stopped before any chat/group/realm could be created because Supabase is not configured.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When you re-run this iteration: (1) FIRST verify /app/frontend/.env now has non-empty REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL and REACT_APP_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY — if still empty, stop again. (2) Confirm the Supabase 'messages' table exists (a quick way: open /messages, click Chats tab, click chats-new-btn, pick tfone, send 'hi' — if you see a red toast 'relation messages does not exist' or a 404/PGRST error in the console, the schema has not been applied yet; report and stop). (3) Only after (1) and (2) pass, run the 4 flows: Chats send, Groups create+send, Realms create+send, and cross-browser realtime using testfriend1 and testfriend2 (use page.context().new_page() or two separate browser contexts). The data-testids you need are documented in the review request.
rca of the issue: Not a bug — expected gate state. Root cause: Supabase environment variables were never populated (intentionally left blank for the user to fill in after creating the Supabase project). The frontend correctly degrades to a 'not configured' UX instead of crashing. No code fix needed; only configuration on the user's side.
